text:
alex: quick q — for config-only changes (yaml, feature flags) do we treat them as semver patch (x.y.Z) or skip releasing and just push? thinking about deploybot defaults.

maya: i'd vote patch when it changes default behavior or any user-observable setting. pure docs/typo fixes = no bump.

sam: +1. example: default cache TTL change -> patch (clients can see altered responses).

liz_h: what about internal config that only affects infra (prom alerts thresholds)? we treat those as noop unless they change public surface.

chris_t: FYI deploy-bot currently auto-increments patch for any PR with label `release/auto-bump`. that seems noisy for some of these cases.

alex: sounds like we need a small decision matrix. my strawman:
- `release/skip` label -> no tag
- `release/patch` label -> bump patch
- config-only AND user-visible/default-change -> patch
- deps-only -> patch only if runtime observable (lockfile + behavior)

maya: also require an `Impact:` line in the PR/changelog: `Impact: behavioral` or `Impact: noop`. that would make automation simpler.

ops-qa: can enforce. Impact=behavioral => 2h canary window + perf checks. Impact=noop => normal rollout.

sam: minor add: allow maintainer override for edge cases via `release/force-hotfix` label — creates hotfix tag even if semver rule wouldn't.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: detected label `release/auto-bump` on PR #4812. proposed action: run `./scripts/release-bump --patch` and create tag `v1.12.4`. 

alex: i want deploy-bot to be slightly smarter: only auto-bump when label present OR when `Impact: behavioral` in the changelog. otherwise prefer no tag.

chris_t: agreed. also add a `--no-buildmeta` flag for patch bumps so we don't spin up different buildmeta on trivial bumps.

liz_h: and require changelog entry template:
```
Impact: behavioral|noop
Rollout-window: normal|night|immediate
Rollback-plan: <link or short bullet>
```

maya: that will make release notes and postmortems way easier.

alex: ok — consensus check: change deploy-bot policy to auto-bump patch only when `release/auto-bump` OR `Impact: behavioral`. add `release/force-hotfix` to force hotfix tags. require changelog template for all releases.

sam: :thumbsup:

ops-qa: we'll update the canary checklist to gate on the Impact field.

alex: i'll open a tiny RFC + PR to update `.deploybot/config.yml` tonight and tag infra for review. thanks everyone.

chris_t: follow-up: add an integration test that rejects PRs with `release/auto-bump` but missing `Impact:` line. saves time.

alex: good call. i'll add that test to the merge pipeline.

deploy-bot: action queued: update policy config, add `impact` enforcement rule.
